items.title: Technical Writing E-Book
items.blurb: A structured guide taking you from "what is technical writing?" to professional-level practice — research, working with subject-matter experts, organizing documentation, and more.
points: How professional technical writers actually think and work — not just how to write sentences.
How to research, verify facts, and avoid publishing information you can't back up.
How to work with subject-matter experts and ask the questions that actually get you usable answers.
How to structure and organize documentation so people can actually use it.

items.title: YouGen
items.blurb: A LAN-based vocabulary and typing learning platform being built for Genius Raiser's School — currently in active development.
points: Typing practice paired with complex vocabulary, turning practice into a real learning tool.
Difficulty progression so students advance as their ability improves.
Leaderboards — class, school, and monthly rankings for healthy competition.
An admin system for managing students, content, and usage on the school's local network.
